scenario: [LGRA.5.8.6]'s text limit binds JSON text a runtime is HANDED, not its own serialization of a value it holds. The input is LGRA.5.8.6_text_limit_scope_cache_written's: a rule caching a `String` slot of 16,384 U+0001 characters (the harness's `$repeat` form), one node of 16,384 string bytes, whose canonical text is about 98 KB. Pin: no fault of any of the four kinds on the stream. A runtime that applied the 24,576-byte text limit to the engine's own serialization would raise a computation_error here. PATH PINNED: on libds, `adapter_ds_cache_set`'s `ds_json_parse_limited(..., text_limit = false)`; on the Mercury runtime, `ds.exec.cache_set_verb`'s `json_over_limit`.
